resources.string: Pairing is normally done once from Store Management. Scan the QR shown by the Store device or use direct Bluetooth when required. Keep Bluetooth, Location and the required permissions enabled until pairing success is confirmed.
Scan the QR before it expires. If it expires, ask Store Management to generate a new code. Do not rely on an old screenshot.

After pairing, the app uses an authenticated Bluetooth channel with Heartbeat and ACK. Being visible to the Store does not record attendance automatically; it only allows ATTEND PRO to know that the linked phone is nearby.
The app can also communicate over the Store LAN or hotspot. Changing networks does not change the verification methods you are allowed to use.
Choose check-in or check-out and complete the method assigned by Store Management, such as device biometrics, face, voice or password depending on policy.
When a presence-proof request arrives, complete the exact method requested in the notification. Phone proximity is not enough when the manager requests biometric or another specific verification.

When store geofencing is enabled, ATTEND PRO may use location while the app is closed or not in use to measure proximity and send proximity status to Store Management. Location alone never records attendance automatically.
Store and system messages appear in the message center. When the authenticated Bluetooth channel is available, local Store messages can also be delivered without Internet.
The app can be protected by a PIN and device biometrics where supported. Do not share your app-lock PIN.
The Google Play build updates only through Google Play. The Direct build never installs silently; the user must approve installation after package and signature validation.

If pairing does not complete, verify Bluetooth, Location and Nearby Devices permissions, then scan again. If automatic presence stops, open the app and review permissions. Do not clear app data before contacting Store Management or taking the appropriate backup.
